items.summary: In backend/main.mo, locate the admin principal storage (stable variable or hardcoded constant) and the isCallerAdmin function (or equivalent authorization check). Ensure the stored admin principal is exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'. The isCallerAdmin comparison must use caller.toText() and compare it directly against this string. If the admin principal is held in a stable variable, set its default/initial value to this principal so it is authoritative on upgrade.

Create or update backend/migration.mo to overwrite the live canister's stored admin principal with 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' during the next canister upgrade, without losing any other stable state (collections, NFT items, user profiles, minted tokens).

In the frontend hook useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout, add or confirm a public query call to the backend's isCallerAdmin method (or equivalent) and log the raw result to the browser console. The console output must include: (1) the caller's principal text, (2) the hardcoded fallback principal, (3) the raw boolean result returned by the backend isCallerAdmin call, and (4) any error thrown. This is to allow immediate diagnosis if a mismatch persists on the live site.
